query: SELECT r.name as role, p.name as permission, p.action FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN role_permissions rp ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE ur.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'staff') LIMIT 20;
